title: Notebook
summary: A Datadog notebook drawn from its snapshot file: markdown cells as prose, timeseries cells as uPlot charts with the incident windows banded over them, toplists as bar lists, log streams as tables, and every other cell as a definition card that opens in Datadog.
belongs: The Evidence section renders every registered notebook; declare one to place a subset of its cells beside the cause it proves.

cells.description: cell indexes to show; default every cell

bands.description: paint the windows and the timestamp rules over each chart; default true
